evidence_quotes.agenda: "do you have any special instructions concerns or stressors about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer asked whether the bed frame would be disassembled; rep gave a complete, direct yes — fully resolved with nothing left to dig into.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "Once we go over the minimum we only charge in fifteen minute intervals."

top_strength: Gave a clean, fully-resolved answer to the disassembly question that removed a real logistics worry in one exchange.
coaching_note: The estimate was a flat minimum-hours quote with no "typical move like this takes X, since your situation is Y expect Z" anchor framing — add that even for moves that land right at the minimum.
